sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet surge of panicked embarrassment and self-reproach, worried that starting the term late has already gone wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I only meant to look at the time...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed, quietly trying to excuse herself while inwardly panicking about being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, with a brief spike of embarrassment and panic as the newspapers hit her face, though she tries to keep the reaction small.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed by the string of mishaps, but is trying to stay composed and push through the morning without panicking.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicked and breathless, clinging to a small burst of hope as she desperately tries not to miss the bus despite everything going wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet, sinking embarrassment and resignation, trying to accept the humiliating bad luck with a small, subdued calm rather than outward frustration.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Good morning. I'm sorry for... this shape.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is mortified and flustered, but trying to stay polite and composed by turning her embarrassment into a quiet, awkward apology.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I haven't ridden one in a while.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shy and uncertain, with a small thread of embarrassment and nervous hesitation about whether she can manage the bicycle after so long.
sprite_sequence.label: shy

sprite_sequence.text: Maybe... maybe I can still make homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly anxious but cautiously hopeful, trying to steady herself and cling to the possibility that the morning can still be salvaged.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Why is there a daikon in the basket...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly stunned and exhausted, with a faint, resigned disbelief at how absurdly unlucky the morning has become.
sprite_sequence.label: confused

sprite_sequence.text: ...This was supposed to be a good start.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly defeated and embarrassed, with a small, resigned sadness at how badly her carefully hoped-for fresh start has unraveled.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: I ironed everything. I checked everything. I really tried.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly crushed and frustrated with herself, holding back tears as she tries to justify her effort and make sense of how badly the morning went wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: I'm fine. Just... losing to vegetables.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is embarrassed and quietly frustrated, trying to cover her near-tears with dry humor while feeling defeated by how absurdly the morning has gone.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and overwhelmed, but also quietly relieved and grateful that someone is helping her after a humiliating morning.
sprite_sequence.label: shy

sprite_sequence.text: Right. Running sounds simpler than cycling.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, quietly accepting help and trying to regain composure with a small, tentative sense of humor.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and relieved in equal measure, with a faint, shy sense of triumph after surviving the morning’s chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Please don't tell anyone about the daikon.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shyly embarrassed and vulnerable, but also relieved and quietly hopeful that he’ll keep her humiliating morning to himself.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed
